memory_update.text: WEST is the best underfollowed public-company fit for the node: small-cap, direct exposure to coffee/tea/extract/private-label/RTD beverage solutions, and explicit foodservice/restaurant/hospitality/customer-channel language.

THS should be tracked as a hidden coffee/private-label asset rather than a restaurant pure-play; key diligence is whether the Farmer Brothers Northlake/direct-ship acquisition creates material coffee category growth or remains buried in a broad private-label portfolio.

JVA is a micro-cap speculative shadow candidate: direct private-label and foodservice coffee relevance but below USD 300M, likely illiquid, and needs customer concentration, balance sheet, margin and commodity pass-through verification before surviving Layer 2.

FARM was historically one of the cleanest public pure-plays for DSD foodservice coffee, equipment service, and hidden chain/customer relationships, but evidence indicates it completed a take-private transaction with Royal Cup in May 2026; retain it as a private benchmark/customer map, not as a current US-listed candidate.

Need a follow-up search specifically for coffee-equipment service networks, beverage-dispensing service vendors, syrups/concentrates, office-coffee-service rollups, and restaurant beverage QA/testing suppliers; current evidence is stronger for roasters/co-manufacturers/distributors than for equipment-service chokepoints.

node: Private-label coffee roasting, beverage ingredients, DSD beverage supply, and equipment service
summary: Expanded the universe for the foodservice coffee and beverage-supply node with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: broad distributor Performance Food Group helps map restaurant, vending, office-coffee, convenience, and specialty beverage distribution economics, but is not pure-play. Underfollowed lane: Westrock Coffee, TreeHouse Foods, and Coffee Holding Co. provide more direct exposure to private-label coffee, beverage solutions, roasting, extraction, direct-ship supply, and foodservice/private-label customers. Farmer Brothers was a strong historical public pure-play, but current evidence indicates it completed a take-private transaction with Royal Cup in May 2026, so it is excluded from the US-listed candidate list and retained only as a private-comparable/relationship-mapping clue.
